'''Mac Ewevs''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Storm commando/Legends|storm commando]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] who served in the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], Captain Ewevs and some other elite soldiers were hired by [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] of [[Concord Dawn/Legends|Concord Dawn]] [[Purton]] to kill [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]. The [[Squad/Legends|squad]] failed and was later tracked by Fett who captured Mac Ewevs on [[Blackfel]].
